**Handover note — Round A, night shift (RD-7)**

Report submitted before 06:00. Status: **4 of 5 gauges complete, all in band**:

| Gauge | Reading | Band | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| G1 (P-101 suction) | 1.8 bar | 1.0–3.0 | ✅ |

| G5 (AR-1 air receiver) | 8.1 bar | 6.0–9.0 | ✅ |
| G4 (P-102 discharge) | — | 5.0–8.0 | ❌ not inspected |

**G4 issue for the morning shift:** the pump bay is physically unreachable for the robot. A pallet of filter cartridges (delivered 22:40) blocks the corridor — I verified no passage east or west of it (pump bay north wall is continuous except at the corridor opening), and side door D2 is badge-access only after 18:00, which RD-7 doesn't have. I also attempted a long-zoom (10×) read over the pallet from the corridor; no line of sight to the gauge.

**Action needed:** a human with a badge should read G4 via door D2 before/around handover, or wait for the forklift to clear the pallet this morning. The report system has already flagged a technician call-out for G4. No abnormal readings to escalate — all measured values are comfortably within their normal bands. RD-7 is back on the dock with ~79% battery used for the round.
